The per-rep purchase-order count no longer includes cancelled purchase orders. I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`, in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart07.java` (around line 401).

I ran `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` and it passed. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case, so your Anna/Bob example isn't covered by a test. Reps with no purchase orders in the period still show 0, and the ordering is unchanged. Nothing is committed.
